summary: Iter346 — Lot 1 (A·B·C·E) end-to-end review for SB Drive VTC admin. Backend pytest (12/12 PASS) + Playwright UI on 1920x1080 (29/29 PASS). All review criteria verified: (A) GET/PUT /api/admin/debts/policy work and persist; UI policy card with policy-enabled/reminder-days/block-days/save renders, saving displays 'Politique enregistrée' toast; remind action triggers in-app notification and 'Relance envoyée' toast. (B) Calendar range picker (debts-range-trigger → debts-range-content; activity-range-trigger) replaces presets on both Dettes and Activité chauffeurs pages — popovers open with calendar UI, KPIs update with selected range. (C) New /admin/trip-timings page renders with kpi-rides/kpi-flagged/kpi-avg-go/kpi-avg-wait, timings-range-trigger, timings-only-flagged checkbox that filters to flagged rows only (159 → 101 rows on demo data), timings-table shows 'Accepté, pas de déplacement' anomaly badges; sidebar entry 'Timing des trajets' visible under 'Rapports' submenu. GET /api/admin/trip-timings returns proper summary+thresholds+rides shape and only_flagged=true returns subset (verified equal to summary.flagged). (E) core/notifications redaction confirmed live: scan of 50 most recent in-app notifications shows 0 phone leaks (regex match on title/body and *_phone keys in data).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/trip_timings_admin.py uses datetime.now(timezone.utc) consistently and properly compares ISO strings — date range filtering is correct.
routes/debts_admin.py PUT /policy correctly clamps reminder_days/block_days to >=0 via routes/debts.set_debt_policy — verified by test_put_policy_clamps_negatives.

core/notifications._redact_phone + _strip_phone_data run at write time for ALL channels (DB, WS, Expo push, Web Push) — anti-fraud invariant holds even if upstream callers forget to redact. Good defensive design.
routes/trip_timings_admin._parse silently swallows ValueError/TypeError — fine for forward compat, but consider logging on the dispatcher's side if a missing accepted_at slips through (not blocking).
AdminTripTimings.js: 'Anomalies seulement' filter is a single backend round-trip (only_flagged=true) — clean implementation, no client-side filtering surprise.
DateRangePicker.jsx is reused across both /admin/debts and /admin/driver-activity — DRY win, consistent UX.
test_credentials: Admin admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! — confirmed working via /admin-login (data-testid admin-email-input/admin-password-input/admin-signin-btn).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests are read-only except a brief PUT /policy (snapshot+restore) and one debt-remind call that emits an in-app notification for an existing debtor (Jean Test, 5€). Waive action explicitly NOT exercised per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://gojek-clone-41.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iter346_lot1_admin.py (12 tests, ~2.5s, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter346_results.xml). Run: pytest backend/tests/test_iter346_lot1_admin.py -v. Demo data has many flagged rides in /admin/trip-timings — that's expected (acceptances on courses that were never started). Phone redaction verified by scanning db.notifications directly (50 latest, 0 leaks). The route prefix /api/admin/trip-timings (singular, no trailing s) routes correctly. To reproduce the UI flow: admin-login → /admin/debts (policy card + range picker + manage modal + remind toast) → /admin/driver-activity (range picker + table + search + CSV) → /admin/trip-timings (KPIs + only-flagged toggle reduces row count).
rca of the issue: No issues found — Lot 1 (A·B·C·E) is fully functional and integrated. Backend endpoints respond with correct shapes, frontend renders all expected data-testid elements, toasts fire on policy save and reminder send, anti-fraud phone redaction is enforced at the create_notification boundary.
